sources.title: IBM CEO Arvind Krishna sits down with CNBC
sources.quote_checked: I fundamentally believe we'll get more jobs. | probably in its fifth or sixth inning of a game | we don't want to constrain where people deploy it | beginning that way was the wrong approach

sources.title: Today's workforce should prepare to work hand in hand with A.I.
sources.quote_checked: shift from 700 professionals doing a relatively manual type of HR-related work, to less than 50 | frees up employees to take on higher-value work | we must start preparing the workforce for collaboration with A.I. tools

sources.title: 'I could easily see 30% workforce getting replaced by AI': IBM CEO Arvind Krishna's candid revelation on job losses
sources.quote_checked: I could easily see 30 per cent of that getting replaced by AI and automation over a five-year period

sources.title: IBM CEO praises 'real' open source for enterprise gen AI as new efforts emerge at Think 2024
sources.quote_checked: If you want people to contribute, it has to be clearly open source, it cannot actually just be open source marketing | They're using the term open just for marketing purposes

sources.title: IBM CEO Arvind Krishna wants to completely transform his organization
sources.quote_checked: focused on hybrid cloud and artificial intelligence, which I believe are the two fundamental forces | the technology base on which to build a hybrid cloud technology platform

sources.title: Aspen Ideas Festival: IBM's Arvind Krishna on skills over degrees
sources.quote_checked: Only 30% of people in the U.S. have four-year degrees | we now have over 50% of our job openings based on skills, not degrees

sources.title: IBM CEO Sees 'Something Remarkable' Happening in Quantum Over Next Three to Five Years
sources.quote_checked: we will see something remarkable happen on that front | I give myself till the end of the decade
